title: ID0396299-DC/Si-D/FI-[OsmxVp] - Broken FC12 aux.contact
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charger was running but all outlets were OoO due to failure in FC12 internal aux.contact. Also LED of FC12 did not work but when the button was pressed, FC13-17 were switched ON . Ticket created for warranty purposes.
No support needed. Please forward this to RC-FI queue.
Root cause:
Broken FC12
Solution:
FC12 need to be replaced.
Done 13.1.2025
